friction.description: check_token() uses global variable FAIL (no `local` declaration). When two calls are made (human token first, agent token second), the second call resets FAIL=0 at line 50, clobbering the outer FAIL=1 set by a failed first call. In adversarial test with forged human token + valid agent token, the script exits 0 despite human token check failures. The product itself (Keycloak realm + JWT contract) is correct; only the fitness function has a variable scoping bug.
friction.product_impact: none — the bug only masks adversarial scenarios, not the normal pass path; normal CI (both tokens real) is unaffected. To fix: add `local FAIL=0` inside check_token() at line 50.
